Callers check ErrEmpty with ==, which compares the interface's type and pointer, not the text. errors.New("port: empty") makes a new pointer every time, so only the ErrEmpty variable itself matches. The other two cases need errors whose dynamic type is exactly *RangeError or *SyntaxError.
Return ErrEmpty for "". Call strconv.Atoi(s): if it fails, return &SyntaxError{Input: s}, not Atoi's own error. If n < 1 or n > 65535, return &RangeError{Value: n}. Otherwise return n, nil.
